about: What Kleio says when pairing over its link fails, one row for each case: the nine the plan tested on the phone, then the further ones.
Each case has words of its own: gg-app/src/kleio/LinkPairing.test.tsx checks no two are the same.
`from` names what says it: the link's PairError (src/pair.rs) or TicketError (src/ticket.rs), or a file in gg-app/src/kleio. Each one's tests check its words against these.
{host}, {device} and {relay} stand for the host's name, this device (iPhone or Mac) and the relay's host name.

`stages` are what pairing shows while it runs, by PairStage: its three steps, then the wait for an admin's Allow, which shows the device code beside its words. The link says "this device" for {device}.

stages.waiting: Waiting for your host to allow this {device}…

cases.case: The same QR code again, after it paired a device
cases.message: This QR code was already used to pair a device. Show a new one on your host and scan that.

cases.case: The code changed
cases.message: The code in this QR code doesn't match your host's. Show a new QR code on your host and scan that.

cases.case: The key changed
cases.message: No host with this QR code's key answered. Check you're scanning the QR code on your own host, and that it's awake.

cases.case: The relay changed to another of n0's
cases.message: Your host is online, but not on the relay this QR code names. Show a new QR code on your host and scan that.

cases.case: The relay changed to an https address that isn't a relay
cases.message: The relay in this QR code ({relay}) isn't a relay. Show a new QR code on your host and scan that.

cases.case: A v2 ticket that isn't whole, such as a link ticket with v changed to 2
cases.message: This QR code says it's a Tailscale pairing code, but it's incomplete. Show a new one on your host.

cases.case: Another type
cases.message: That isn't a Kleio pairing code.

cases.case: A code older than 5 minutes
cases.message: This QR code has expired: codes last 5 minutes. Show a new one on your host and scan it.

cases.case: A key the host doesn't know, on kleio/http/0 (close code 1)
cases.message: {host} doesn't know this {device}. It may have been set up again. Pair it again.

cases.case: A revoked device (close code 5)
cases.message: {host} removed this {device}. This {device} was revoked on {host}, so {host} turns it away. Pair it again to use Kleio here.

cases.case: No code waiting
cases.message: Your host isn't waiting for a pairing code. Show a new QR code on your host and scan that.

cases.case: Too many wrong tries
cases.message: Too many wrong codes were tried with this QR code. Show a new QR code on your host and scan that.

cases.case: A code replaced by a newer one
cases.message: Your host has shown a newer QR code since this one. Scan the newest one.

cases.case: The host pairing another device (close code 2)
cases.message: Your host is pairing another device. Try again in a minute.

cases.case: A relay that can't be reached
cases.message: Kleio can't reach the relay in this QR code ({relay}). Check this device is online, or try another network.

cases.case: An admin's Deny, or the QR code closed or run out while the device waited
cases.message: Your host didn't allow this device. To try again, show a new QR code on your host and scan that.

cases.case: A QR code another device is already waiting on
cases.message: Another device is already waiting to pair with this QR code. Show a new QR code on your host and scan that.

cases.case: No admin's Allow within 2 minutes
cases.message: Nobody allowed this device on your host within 2 minutes. Show a new QR code on your host, scan it, then allow the device there.

cases.case: A host whose kleio-link-host is older than its kleio-host, so the device's wait isn't passed on
cases.message: Part of Kleio on your host is out of date, so it can't pair this device. Update Kleio on your host, then show a new QR code.

cases.case: A v3 ticket, from the connection prototype's test build
cases.message: This QR code comes from a test build of Kleio's link. Update Kleio on your host, then show a new QR code and scan that.

cases.case: This device offline
cases.message: This {device} is offline. Connect it to the internet, then try again.
